description: This file defines a Java Spring MVC controller class named MatriculaController that handles HTTP requests related to course enrollment (matricula). It manages operations such as saving matriculas, interacts with service and repository layers, and handles role-based authorization.

classes.name: MatriculaController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller managing course registration operations, secured with role-based access, handling HTTP GET requests to enroll users in courses.

methods.name: saveMatricula
methods.description: Handles GET requests to register a user for a course identified by 'id_curso', interacts with service and repository layers, and returns view names based on success or failure.
